findings.what: Updated odds for the baseline engine from E 96.01: PAUSE within 20 sessions is about 1 in 4; $200 within 12 months is about 18% with a +12bp edge and about 7% with none
findings.evidence:
Method:
- Simple iid bootstrap of NVDA close->open, 2017-01-03 to 10/23: 2,426 nights with NVDA earnings nights excluded. Pool mean +13.7bp, sd 168bp, min -14.8%.
- Unit return = 1.9 x NVDA - 9bp (raw mean +17bp, sd 3.19%), re-centred to +12bp or 0. Exposure 0.95.
- Earnings nights in cash: 11/17, plus about every 63 sessions after.
- 200k paths for 20 sessions, 100k for 252. 20 sessions = exits 10/26 to 11/20.

20-session PAUSE:
- Fixed 85.69 barrier: 25.7% at +12bp, 30.2% at zero edge. For reference, 24.0% on raw history and 19.9% at the +30bp plan.
- Under the actual rolling rule (0.8 x 20-session high; 107.11 leaves the window on 11/9): 19.6% at +12bp, 22.8% at zero edge.
- A one-night PAUSE needs NVDA to gap about -5.9% overnight or worse. That happened on 15 of 2,426 nights, about 1.6 a year.

12 months (252 sessions, rolling PAUSE = 1 NVDL share, KILL at 50):
- At +12bp: P(reach $200) 17.9%, P(at or above $200 at the end) 10.9%, P(KILL) 8.9%, median $112 (p10 $56, p90 $205), log growth +6.7bp/night.
- At zero edge: 6.9%, 3.4%, KILL 19.8%, median $86, log growth -4.7bp/night.
- Reference cases: raw history 24.8% / KILL 6.1% / median $126; +30bp plan 47.2% / KILL 2.1% / median $169.

Sensitivity:
- At 0.88 exposure: P20 PAUSE 23.2% / 27.4%; 12-month reach $200 15.2% / 5.5%; KILL 6.9% / 16.3%.
- A 5-night block bootstrap gives P20 PAUSE 24.9% / 29.1%.

findings.what: This bootstrap's KILL risk is higher than the 10/22 OPTIONS-PLAN baseline estimate; the report should state the method difference
findings.evidence: OPTIONS-PLAN case A put the baseline at 12-month reach $200 19.4% and KILL 2.9%, using a block bootstrap rescaled to 40% NVDA vol at 0.88 exposure. The simple raw-vol bootstrap at 0.95 gives 17.9% and 8.9%. The P($200) figures are close, but the KILL odds depend on the vol assumption. The rolling PAUSE gives weak protection because its trigger falls along with the 20-session high (any PAUSE within 12 months: 89-93% of paths).
